content.user_title: Research the Web with Structured Subagents
content.value_statement: Complex web research can become scattered and hard to verify. This skill plans subtopics, delegates searches, and synthesizes cited findings into a clear answer.
actual_capabilities: Creates a local research folder and saved research plan before delegation.
Breaks research questions into two to five distinct subtopics.
Delegates subtopics to up to three research subagents in parallel.
Limits each subagent to three to five web searches.
Synthesizes local finding files with source URLs and noted gaps.
Can write an optional final research report file.
limitations: Requires task, web_search, fetch_url, write_file, read_file, and list_files tools to be available.
Does not verify paywalled, blocked, or unavailable sources.
May miss recent updates if search results are incomplete.
Needs clear topic names to keep generated file paths organized.

use_cases.title: Competitive Landscape Brief
use_cases.description: Compare vendors, positioning, pricing signals, and recent announcements using multiple cited sources.

use_cases.title: Policy and Regulatory Scan
use_cases.description: Gather current public information across agencies, news sources, and expert commentary for a focused policy question.

use_cases.title: Technical Topic Survey
use_cases.description: Research tools, standards, tutorials, and implementation guidance before drafting technical documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Fact Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to answer: [question]. Keep the scope simple and cite the main sources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a practical comparison.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to compare [option A], [option B], and [option C] for [criteria]. Create a concise synthesis with source URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Market Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request covering several research angles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to research [market or topic]. Split the work into demand, competitors, recent news, and risks. Produce an executive brief.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Conflicting Claims
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request requiring evidence quality checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to investigate these claims: [claims]. Assign separate subagents to supporting evidence, opposing evidence, and source quality. Summarize confidence and gaps.

output_examples.input: Research recent adoption trends for vector databases.
output_examples.output: A concise report covering adoption drivers, notable vendors, recent signals, source links, and research limits.

output_examples.input: Compare three customer support automation platforms.
output_examples.output: A comparison brief covering features, pricing signals, integrations, tradeoffs, and cited public sources.

output_examples.input: Investigate whether two public claims about a market are supported.
output_examples.output: A synthesis that separates supported evidence, disputed evidence, source quality concerns, and remaining gaps.

best_practices: Define a narrow research question before invoking the skill.
Use distinct subtopics so subagents do not duplicate searches.
Review source URLs and gaps before relying on the final report.
anti_patterns: Asking for broad research without a clear decision or question.
Letting several subagents investigate the same subtopic.
Treating search snippets as evidence without reading sources.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan web research, delegate subtopics, collect findings, and synthesize cited answers.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it browse the web directly?
faq.answer: It instructs research subagents to use web_search and fetch_url tools when those tools are available.

faq.question: Where are research files saved?
faq.answer: The skill saves plans, findings, and optional reports in a local research folder for the topic.

faq.question: How many subagents does it use?
faq.answer: It recommends up to three parallel research subagents, each with a limited search budget.

faq.question: Can it guarantee complete accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on available sources, search quality, and review of citations and gaps.
